grammar_concept.title: Inversion for Emphasis
grammar_concept.rule: Move a negative or limiting adverbial (never, rarely, seldom, not only, no sooner, little) to the start of a sentence for emphasis, and invert the subject and auxiliary verb — just like in a question.
grammar_concept.simple_explanation: This is a formal, emphatic way of saying something, common in writing and in confident speech. The key rule: the moment you start a sentence with one of these adverbials, the subject and the auxiliary swap places.
grammar_concept.example: Never have I seen such a mess. Not only did she win the race, but she also broke the record.
grammar_concept.example_translation: Nunca vi tal bagunça. Não só ela ganhou a corrida, como também bateu o recorde.
grammar_concept.common_mistake_pt: O português cria ênfase através da entoação ou de reforços lexicais ("nunca na vida vi", "foi mesmo aquela que"), não através de uma estrutura gramatical fixa que exija inverter sujeito e verbo. Isto leva a manter a ordem normal de afirmação depois do advérbio inicial ("Never I have seen" em vez de "Never have I seen"), esquecendo a inversão obrigatória.
grammar_concept.correction: Depois de um advérbio negativo/restritivo no início da frase (Never, Rarely, Not only, No sooner, Little), inverta sempre o auxiliar e o sujeito, tal como numa pergunta: "Never have I seen", "Rarely does he complain".
grammar_concept.real_world_example: A formal complaint letter: "Never have I experienced such poor service."

vocabulary.definition_en: not often; only a few times
example_sentences: Rarely does he arrive on time.

vocabulary.definition_en: used to add emphasis by mentioning two facts, the second often more surprising
related_forms: not only did she..., but she also...
example_sentences: Not only was the flight delayed, but our luggage was also lost.

vocabulary.definition_en: used to say that one thing happened immediately after another
example_sentences: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.

exercises.prompt: Complete: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explanation: Depois de "Never" no início, inverte-se o auxiliar e o sujeito: "have I seen".
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Manter a ordem normal ("I have seen") depois de "Never" é o erro mais comum aqui.

exercises.prompt: Complete: Rarely ___ so nervous before a presentation.
exercises.explanation: Depois de "Rarely" no início, inverte-se o auxiliar e o sujeito: "has she felt".
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Usar "did she felt" (dupla marcação de passado, "did" + "felt") é um erro comum ao tentar formar a inversão.

exercises.prompt: Which expression means one thing happened immediately after another, like "___ had I sat down than the phone rang"?
exercises.explanation: "No sooner...than" indica que uma coisa aconteceu logo a seguir a outra.

exercises.prompt: Listen to the audio. What happened, according to the speaker?
correct_answer: the flight was delayed and the luggage was lost
exercises.explanation: No áudio, ouve-se: "Not only was the flight delayed, but our luggage was also lost."
exercises.transcript: It was a disastrous trip. Not only was the flight delayed by six hours, but our luggage was also lost, and we never got it back.

exercises.prompt: Read: "No sooner had the meeting started than the fire alarm went off." What happened first?
distractors: both at exactly the same time
exercises.explanation: "No sooner...than" indica que a reunião começou primeiro, e o alarme tocou logo a seguir.

exercises.prompt: Translate to English (usando a estrutura enfática com inversão): "Nunca tinha ouvido uma história tão triste."
correct_answer: Never had I heard such a sad story.
exercises.explanation: Depois de "Never" no início, inverte-se o auxiliar e o sujeito: "had I heard", nunca "I had heard".
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Manter a ordem normal ("Never I had heard") em vez de inverter é o erro mais comum aqui.

steps.content: The inverted auxiliary carries strong stress, since it's doing the emphatic work of the sentence: "NEVER have I seen", "RARELY does he complain" — flattening the stress removes the whole emphatic effect.

steps.prompt: Say 2 emphatic sentences about your own experiences, starting with 'Never' or 'Rarely', remembering to invert the subject and auxiliary.
Write 3 emphatic sentences using inversion — one with 'Never', one with 'Not only...but also', and one with 'No sooner...than'.
